Greydwarf shaman

Internal ID: Greydwarf_Shaman | Faction: Forest | Main biome: Black Forest | Drops: Greydwarf eye | Greydwarf Shaman trophy | Resin | Wood | Bukeperries | Abilities: Magic attack (8s), Attack (2s), Heal (10s) | Trophy: Greydwarf Shaman trophy | Very weak to (x2): Fire | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Stagger | Resistant to (x0.5): Poison | Immune to (x0): Spirit, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 33%

Introduction. Greydwarf shamans are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests. They are mossy tree-like beings that act primarily as healers in patrols while also possessing the ability to cast a ranged poison attack.

Magic attack. [1] Creates a 7-meter 35-degree conical blast that inflicts Poison (30 Poison damage). This ability can be used every 8 seconds within 2–5 meters of a player, making it possible to disable the attack by standing close. This attack cannot be blocked.

Attack. Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (14 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

Heal. Lifts both hands up to create a healing mist that heals allies for a total of 20 health, ticking every 0.5 seconds in a 4.32-meter radius around the shaman. However, the effect only lasts for 3.5 seconds, meaning that 17.5 health is healed instead of the full 20.

Notes. • Whereas ordinary Greydwarf shamans have brown bark flecked with green, One-star Greydwarf shamans have green bark flecked with teal, and Two-stars have blue bark flecked with teal.
